# Apex development skills for Salesforce

Skills for Salesforce Platform development with Apex: bulk-safe trigger handlers, recursion control, user-mode data access, and tests that cover full 200-record trigger batches.

Every Apex sample in the skill and its tests is parsed with the open-source Apex parser from apex-dev-tools. Deployment and test execution need a Salesforce org; the Salesforce DX MCP server is documented in mcp/servers.yaml for users who want agent access to a scratch org.

| Field | Value |

## Skills

| Skill | Use it for | Prerequisites |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [salesforce-apex-trigger-framework](skills/salesforce-apex-trigger-framework/SKILL.md) | Implement Apex triggers with the one-trigger-per-object handler pattern: bulk-safe logic, recursion control that works across 200-record chunks, user-mode data access, field-level errors, and unit tests with full batches. | Salesforce org with Apex enabled (Developer Edition, sandbox, or scratch org) and API version 60.0 or later for WITH USER_MODE, AccessLevel.USER_MODE, and the Assert class. Salesforce CLI (sf) to deploy and run tests. |

## Install

```text
# Claude Code
/plugin marketplace add enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills
/plugin install salesforce-platform@enterprise-agent-skills

# GitHub Copilot CLI
copilot plugin marketplace add enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills
copilot plugin install salesforce-platform@enterprise-agent-skills

# OpenAI Codex CLI (the Codex IDE extension does not support plugins)
codex plugin marketplace add enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills
# then enter /plugins in Codex, install salesforce-platform, and start a new session

# Any Agent Skills compatible agent (Copilot in VS Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and others)
npx skills add enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills --skill salesforce-apex-trigger-framework
```

Claude Cowork and claude.ai: Customize > Plugins > Add > Add marketplace, then enter `https://github.com/enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills`.

To update:

- Claude Code: run `claude plugin update salesforce-platform@enterprise-agent-skills` in your shell, or open the plugin on the **Installed** tab of `/plugin` and select **Update now**. Claude Code does not update plugins from this marketplace automatically unless you turn it on: select `enterprise-agent-skills` on the **Marketplaces** tab of `/plugin`, then **Enable auto-update**.
- GitHub Copilot CLI: run `copilot plugin update salesforce-platform`.
- Claude Cowork and claude.ai: in Customize > Plugins, select **Check for updates**, or turn on **Sync automatically** for this marketplace.
- Skills installed with `npx skills`: run `npx skills update salesforce-apex-trigger-framework`.

## Data and permissions

This plugin contains instructions and reference documents only. It bundles no MCP servers or hooks and sends no data anywhere by itself. Any data access happens through tools you have already connected to your agent.

## Tests

Acceptance criteria and scenarios for each skill live in [tests/scenarios](../../tests/scenarios). Run `npm run eval:mock -- --skill <name>` from the repository root.
